title: Huge fire rips through residential homes in Manila
summary: Local reports say at least 14 fire trucks were called to the fire in the residential area, resulting in an evacuation to two nearby centres.

title: Animal shelter workers hospitalised after FBI uses furnace to burn seized meth
summary: Fourteen staff were hospitalised and 75 cats and dogs evacuated.

title: Charlie Kirk memorial service set to take place in Arizona stadium
summary: Turning Point USA, the organisation Kirk co-founded, announced the event will be held on 21 September.
